## Symptoms
The orders queue grows steadily. Submissions succeed, but processed orders per second drop below the arrival rate.

## Likely causes
1. The consumer is processing each message slowly.
2. The consumer is stalled or has lost its connection.

## How to confirm
Check consumer throughput against arrival rate. Look at unacked messages: a flat unacked count with growing ready messages means the consumer is not taking work.

## Fix options
Restart or scale the consumer after finding the slow step. Do not purge the queue.

## Escalate when
Backlog exceeds one hour of normal traffic.
